rationale: One prior finding from the human-reviewer discussion on MR !4682 is re-verified against current source and confirmed resolved. No other findings were open.

finding_status.notes: Reviewer finding: resolve_creator_names used query_users_by_uuid_batched, which has no deleted_at IS NULL filter, so a soft-deleted creator's name would still be shown instead of null. Fixed in commit 1eba8e306: resolve_creator_names now calls UserRepository.aget_users_by_ids (src/codemie/service/budget/budget_service.py), which filters deleted_at IS NULL (src/codemie/repository/user_repository.py:597). Covered by tests/codemie/service/budget/test_budget_service.py::TestResolveCreatorNames::test_soft_deleted_creator_is_omitted. Source and test confirmed.
